text.tspan: Income inequality: Palma ratio (after tax) 1963 to 2024
The Palma ratio is a measure of inequality that divides the share received by the richest 10% by the share of the
poorest 40%. Higher values indicate higher inequality. Inequality is measured here in terms of income after
